faq.q: How much does Parke Injury Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Parke Injury Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Parke Injury Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Parke Injury Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.a: Parke Injury Law Firm publishes one office, in Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.
